utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara—could you help sort the donated tools and keep track of what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated tools and keep a list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got a clear plan: we’re still collecting donations through Thursday, then I’ll sort the parts list Friday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I'll check back Friday and help with the parts list if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Mara, I’m in—what time should I swing by for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — could you come by around 10 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10 a.m. works for me — I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details, just to make sure I’ve got them right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — it’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday at the community center, and folks can drop off small appliances, bikes, and loose tools. I can double-check the exact time if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you double-check the exact time for me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a note on what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that’ll help a lot. I’m usually running late, so I can grab whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the list updated and let you know what’s still missing before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you remind me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — we just need people to drop off any broken small appliances or tools at the community center by 5. I can send you the list if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes please, send me the list — I’ll try to gather anything broken and swing by before 5.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey—thank you. We could use someone to help sort supplies and keep track of donations.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. Just point me to the supplies, and I’ll keep an eye on the donations too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Totally fair — I’ll keep it simple and make a quick plan for who brings what, then we can check the timing together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good—if you can jot down the plan, I can check the timing and see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much progress have we made on the repair drive, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive! I’ve got a few things lined up, but I should check my notes and see what’s actually done.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you tell me what’s done and what still needs work?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s moving along, but I only caught the quick version—folks are still gathering parts and volunteers. If you want, I can check the full update and tell you the important bits.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo—I'd appreciate the full update when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s coming up soon, right? I’ve been hearing a few folks on the block already planning to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s coming up. I’m glad people are thinking about helping out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s good to hear — I’ll spread the word and see if anyone needs a hand. Maybe we can get a nice little turnout this time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand and bring whatever tools we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — can you double-check which tools we’ll need and when you can bring them?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check the list and make sure we’ve got the basics—hammer, screwdriver set, wrench, tape measure, and a drill if needed. I can bring them by tomorrow morning before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling everyone about the repair drive — you should come by too! We could always use another friendly pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I can stop by and help for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Rey — I really appreciate it! Swing by anytime, and I’ll make sure you know where we need the most help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where the repair drive is happening—just tell me the location and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Opal — let’s note it at the community hall on Maple Street. I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the repair drive at the community hall on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — just bring your toolbox if you can, and maybe a few sturdy gloves. We’re starting at the community shed after lunch, and I’ll fill you in when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring my toolbox and gloves and head to the community shed after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right? I just want to be sure before I plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. I’ll send the final details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — I’ll wait for your final details then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Sam — I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’m happy to help coordinate the next steps. What do you want to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs first, and I can help gather a few neighbors to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Sam — let’s flag the urgent fixes and I’ll group them by priority so we can assign neighbors quickly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check our supplies list and see what we’re short on. If you want, I’ll start with tools, tape, and spare fasteners.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds good — start there and let me know what we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass the word along and remind folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate that. I’m still catching up on who needs what, so I’m grateful you’re spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep reminding people and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—just let me know the plan for the repair drive, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send over the repair drive plan once I’ve lined up the school schedule, and then we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Faye—send it over once it’s set, and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I can help out, I just need a quick reminder of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need someone to sort the donations and check what tools are already there. I’m a bit worried about the timing, so I’d like to keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll sort the donations and take a look at the tools we already have.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I have to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—what kind of help can you offer?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can quietly sort donations and help carry boxes, just not be front and center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I connect with first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you start with the block captain and the folks on Maple Street? I just want to make sure we’re reaching the people most likely to need it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll reach out to the block captain and Maple Street folks first. If you want, I can also keep you posted on who I hear back from.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive’s getting a good turnout today—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, I can swing by the hardware store and grab anything else we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks! If you can, grab a few boxes of screws and some painter’s tape—we’re almost set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem—I’ll grab the screws and painter’s tape on my way back. See you there in a bit!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule, but I’ll need the repair drive details first. What time and where should I plan for?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — the repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to noon at the community center parking lot. I’ll bring the tools and a sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — I’ll plan around Saturday morning and head to the community center parking lot at 9.
